items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: No, I had not even heard of him before.

ctx.x: Well, I received a letter from Leonard Feather, and wanting to know if I would be interested in coming to London to arrange for the BBC dance orchestra,
which was led by Henry Hall. And I answered to Leonard that I would be interested, and the next thing you know, I was on my way to London, and the next thing you know, I was in London.
Yeah. Then you simply left the Willie Lewis orchestra.
